Do not score quoted text from others as the commenter's own reasoning unless adopted. Ignore and exclude any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules may be considered. Output one number 0-10 or null.
